description: This file defines constants, enums, structs, and function prototypes for git checkout routines in the libgit2 library, including checkout strategies, notification callbacks, and options structures.

methods.name: git_checkout_init_options
methods.description: Initializes a git_checkout_options structure with default values, setting the version field appropriately.

methods.name: git_checkout_head
methods.description: Updates files in the working directory to match the content of HEAD, with specified checkout options.

methods.name: git_checkout_index
methods.description: Updates files in the working directory to match the index, with specified checkout options.

methods.name: git_checkout_tree
methods.description: Updates files in the working directory to match the content of a specified treeish object, with options.
